data.narrative:
Wisk Aero, a Series C aerospace company founded by Gary Gysin, has raised $450M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 6 private companies in Space & Aerospace at Series B through Series D stages, alongside 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $450M in total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $765M. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue figures. The peer dataset includes Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D), and Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $650M (low) to $2.1B (high), with a median of $1.3B. Key uncertainties include material divergence in the peer set—the $8.0B Sierra Space valuation creates upper-tail inflation—and the absence of revenue or forward metrics to benchmark Wisk Aero's competitive position within the aerospace subsector.
